entries.name: Blue Bottle Coffee (Dusit Central Park)
entries.description: First Thailand store of the Oakland specialty-coffee brand, opened 21 Aug on Level 1 of Central Park with NOLA iced coffee, Thai-exclusive pastries and Southeast Asia's first full Kyoto-style espresso tap bar.

entries.name: Harper's
entries.description: North American-French brasserie that opened with Fairmont's first Thailand hotel on 18 Aug.

entries.name: CAYA Pool Club
entries.description: Poolside night-market-inspired venue serving contemporary takes on Thai street food with cocktails; opened 18 Aug.

entries.name: AELA Social Bar
entries.description: Daytime lounge that shifts into a cocktail-led bar at night, part of the Fairmont's 18 Aug debut.

entries.name: ThaiCoon
entries.description: Casual 'Real Thai, No Rules' newcomer beside Pullman Hotel G from chef Buddy Hatayodom and chef Wai of Rasik Local Kitchen; in soft opening, dinner Tue-Sun.

entries.name: Blue Bottle Coffee (EmQuartier)
entries.description: Second Thai outpost billed as the flagship, weighted toward hand-brewed pour-overs; slated to open later in August.

entries.name: Wiggle Room
entries.description: Fairmont's below-ground supper club with live music and cabaret, opening mid-September.

entries.name: Carito's x Local Canteen / Dibuk House
entries.description: Two-night Phuket Old Town takeover 28-29 Aug bringing Southern Thai cooking and Phuket bar culture to Sukhumvit 22 - a pop-up, not a permanent opening.

trend_note: This week's openings were driven almost entirely by big international brands and hotel F&B - Blue Bottle's Thailand debut and Fairmont's three-venue launch - rather than independent operators; verified independent openings from Thai-language outlets were thin.
